name: @pipeworx/mcp-chess

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Get a Chess.com player's profile by username (e.g., 'hikaru'). Returns title, country, followers, join date, and last online time.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get a CHESS.COM player's ratings and game records across daily, rapid, blitz, and bullet formats. PREFER for "<player>'s blitz/bullet/rapid rating on Chess.com", "what is <player> rated on Chess.com". Returns current/best ratings and win/loss/draw counts.

tools.name: get_games
tools.description: Retrieve a player's completed games for a specific month (format: YYYY/MM, e.g., '2024/01'). Returns game URLs, time controls, results, and ratings.

tools.name: get_leaderboards
tools.description: Check top-ranked Chess.com players by format (daily, rapid, blitz, bullet). Returns rankings with ratings and win percentages.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-chess forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the chess pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
